definitions.explanation: The current month; the month we are in now. Used to talk about events or plans within the present month.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{今月|こんげつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{今月|こんげつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

{今月|こんげつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{終|お}わり→終わり：01361_owari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦なので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I'm planning to go on a trip with friends at the end of this month, so I'm already looking forward to it.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{晴|は}れる→晴れる：00701_hareru⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: There was a lot of rain this month, but next month will have many sunny days, so I'm looking forward to going out.

notes:
TIME REFERENCE SERIES:
- ⟦{先月|せんげつ}→先月：00751_sengetsu⟧: last month
- {今月|こんげつ}: this month
- ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧: next month

The prefix こん- ("this, current") forms a pattern with other time words:
- ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧: today (irregular reading)
- ⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧: this week
- ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧: this year (irregular reading)
- ⟦{今朝|けさ}→今朝：02877_kesa⟧: this morning (irregular reading)

USAGE:
Can function as both a noun ({今月|こんげつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧, "this month is busy") and adverbially with no particle ({今月|こんげつ}⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧, "it arrives this month").

No particle is needed when it modifies a verb; ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is not used with {今月|こんげつ} the way it is with a specific date.
